Over time there is need to configure every kind of allow lists, like *-src and frame-ancestors for Content-Security-Policy (current requirements 14.4.3 and 14.4.7), allowed Origin's (14.2.3, 13.5.2, 14.5.3), allow list of resources or systems to which the server can send requests or load data/files from (12.5.2).

Problem to solve - if it's not documented, then sooner or later it's not clear, why there is some item in allow list and those may stay there even if thay are not needed (anymore).

Idea - create new requirement which requires those whitelists to be documented. Category probably 1.14.
